title: Promote the compiler out of the frozen spike, and route its output through xpr.j
spec: Spawned by T-9 (spec section 6). T-9 added xpr.j(float8)->jsonb, which is IMMUNE to the extra_float_digits session setting because it carries its own SET clause. Nothing generates calls to it yet, and that is the gap this ticket closes. The demo's queries emit bare to_jsonb(<float8>) at the projection, so they still read the session GUC -- at efd 0 or -3 they return SHORT numbers (T-3 mechanism M3, 62-66 wrong answers across T-6's batteries). That emission comes from spikes/T-1/proto/compile.py, which the demo loads DIRECTLY (demo/builder.py:92) and which is FROZEN EVIDENCE: sha b71b153802d0df94 is cited in T-6's attestation and in all 42 battery outputs, so it can never be edited. It needs exactly the promotion T-8 gave runtime.sql -- a canonical home outside spikes/, with the spike copy left byte-identical -- and then its to_jsonb(<float8>) emission routed through xpr.j. ALSO IN SCOPE: a test that the same pick returns identical values at efd 1, 0 and -3, which is the real proof the pin no longer matters. Until this lands the demo is protected only by demo/server/db.py pinning and verifying the GUC per connection -- real protection, but by convention at the edge rather than by construction.
